questions.question: What would come in blank space (1)?
questions.questionHtml: What would come in blank space (1)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'independent'.
 
Key Points
  • The passage discusses the relationship between agriculture and nature.
  • The appropriate word should indicate whether agriculture is separate or not from natural biota.
  • "Independent" fits well as it correctly suggests that agriculture is seen as a separate entity from natural biota, which aligns with the context.
  • Other options ("dependent", "relevant", "consequent") do not fit the context of describing the relationship between agriculture and natural biota.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.
 
Complete Passage: Most of our food comes from agriculture, so we tend to believe that it is independent of natural biota. This is not true. In nature, _______ plants and animals ______ to the rigours of natural selection. Only the fittest survive. _______ wild populations have numerous traits for competitiveness, resistance to parasites, ________ to adverse conditions, _______ other aspects of vigour. In contrast, populations grown for many _______ under the pampered conditions of agriculture tend to lose these traits, because they _______ for production, not resilience. For example, a high-producing plant _______ lacks resistance to drought is ________ and the resistance to drought is ignored. Also, in the process of breeding plants for maximum production, all genetic variation is eliminated.
 
Additional Information
  • Dependent (निर्भर): "Dependent" means relying on something else, which does not fit the idea of separation indicated in the passage.
  • Relevant (प्रासंगिक): "Relevant" means closely connected or appropriate, which is not fitting for the context of relationship between agriculture and natural biota.
  • Consequent (परिणामी): "Consequent" means following as a result, which is not appropriate in this context.

The correct answer is 'irrigated'.
 
Key Points

  • The appropriate word should describe a measure taken to ensure that a high-producing plant can thrive, despite its lack of resistance to drought.
  • "Irrigated" fits well as it refers to the supply of water to plants to assist them in growing, thereby addressing their inability to withstand drought.
  • Other options ("heated", "showered", "deserted") do not fit the context of compensating for a lack of drought resistance in agricultural settings.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.
